spatial_t2_s0.task: pick up the black bowl from table center and place it on the plate
clauses: The akita black bowl is picked from the table center.
The akita black bowl is placed on the plate.

hover.name: hover_akita_bowl
hover.criterion: The akita black bowl sits directly under the gripper in the wrist view, the gripper is a palm's height or less above it, and the jaws are open.

verdict.because: The gripper is positioned directly above the akita black bowl at a height of 103 mm (approx. a palm's height) with jaws fully open.

clauses.what: The akita black bowl sits directly under the gripper in the wrist view
clauses.evidence: The wrist camera shows the bowl centered in the field of view, directly below the gripper jaws.

clauses.what: the gripper is a palm's height or less above it
clauses.evidence: The measured height is 103 mm, which is approximately a palm's height (100 mm).
The gripper status is reported as FULLY OPEN with an opening of 80.0 mm.

take.name: take_akita_bowl
take.criterion: The robot reports that it is HOLDING the akita black bowl.

verdict.because: The robot reports holding an object, and the wrist view confirms the jaws are grasping the rim of the patterned bowl.

clauses.what: The akita black bowl is picked from the table center.
clauses.evidence: The gripper is holding the patterned bowl, lifting it from the table surface.

replan.trigger: carry_akita_bowl (attempt 1) was judged not_done: the camera located "plate", which shares no word with the target "akita black bowl"

subgoals.name: hover_akita_bowl
subgoals.subgoal: Open the jaws, move the gripper over the akita black bowl in the center of the table (the patterned bowl near the stove), and lower it until it hovers about a palm's height above the bowl, jaws still open.
subgoals.criterion: The akita black bowl sits directly under the gripper in the wrist view, the gripper is a palm's height or less above it, and the jaws are open.

subgoals.name: take_akita_bowl
subgoals.subgoal: Descend the rest of the way until the jaws are level with the rim of the akita black bowl, with the rim between them, and close.
subgoals.criterion: The robot reports that it is HOLDING the akita black bowl.

subgoals.name: lift_akita_bowl
subgoals.subgoal: Raise the gripper straight up by about 15 cm without letting go of the akita black bowl.
subgoals.criterion: The tool has risen at least 120 mm since this step began and the robot still reports holding the akita black bowl.

subgoals.name: carry_akita_bowl_retry
subgoals.subgoal: Move the gripper sideways at this height until the akita black bowl is over the plate (the white dish with red rings), still holding it.
subgoals.criterion: The akita black bowl is over the plate and the robot still reports holding it.

subgoals.name: put_akita_bowl_retry
subgoals.subgoal: Lower the gripper until the akita black bowl is just above the plate, then open the jaws to let it go.
subgoals.criterion: The jaws are open and the akita black bowl rests on the plate, its middle over the middle of the plate.

subgoals.name: retreat_akita_bowl_retry
subgoals.subgoal: Raise the gripper straight up by about 15 cm.
subgoals.criterion: The tool has risen at least 120 mm since this step began.
